_comment: The verified price database. Every row carries a date and a receipt. Prices are read by a human from the service's own page; the machine only proposes (see tools/harvest.mjs). History points are dated snapshots of the same page. Do not add a row without a `verified` date and a `receipt`.

rows.note: Price shown in the French storefront, tax included.
Student plan, requires an eligible higher-education account.
Introductory rate of 39 EGP/month for six months applies to new subscribers; the standing price is 79 EGP/month. Payable by card or through a mobile carrier.
Student plan, one account, discounted rate.
Introductory rate of 22,50 MAD/month for six months applies to new subscribers; the standing price is 45 MAD/month. A prepaid year is 450 MAD, i.e. 37,50 MAD/month.
Sold as "Premium Standard". In March 2021 the same plan cost 19,99 SAR — a rise of 20% in five and a half years. The Saudi storefront now uses its own tier names.
Sold as "Premium Platinum": one account, up to three people. Saudi Arabia does not use the Duo or Family tier names.
Sold as "Premium للطلاب": one account, discounted rate.
9,99 €/month after the seven-day trial. Included in Apple One from 19,95 €/month.
Apple TV+ is not sold standalone in Egypt. It is included in every iCloud+ plan at no extra cost, so the price quoted is the iCloud+ entry tier starting at EGP 49.99/month.

The Tunisian storefront listed a student plan at 6,50 DT in November 2025. It is no longer listed as of 21 October 2026 — this is the last price we saw, not a current offer. The same page also sold a mobile-only plan at 2,50 DT per week.
